systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology

facts.fact: Minister Emma Theofelus said consultations on the draft Cybercrime Bill, covering online harassment, cyberstalking, image-based abuse and deepfakes, resume in February 2026.
Minister Emma Theofelus confirmed the Data Protection Bill is ready to be re-submitted to cabinet, a step before it is tabled in parliament.

ChannelAfrica reports government is rolling out rural connectivity through the Universal Service Fund, which has financed new telecommunications towers giving free internet to schools and clinics in remote areas, with no count given.

NAM.note: No budget amount, own-resource statement or spending report is stated.
